verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a built-in 'Radar' feature explicitly for bot/fraud/abuse protection (workos-docs-12, workos-supp-radar) alongside MFA (workos-docs-11), but the evidence never specifically describes credential-stuffing or brute-force mitigations (e.g., rate limiting, anomaly detection specifics) or provides independent/hands-on validation of Radar's effectiveness. missing for 10: explicit credential-stuffing/brute-force protection mechanics, independent third-party validation of Radar's efficacy.
